notes: Direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (no block). Checked main nav/mega-menu, collections.json (750 collections across 3 pages), and sitemap_collections_1.xml for Clearance/Outlet/Final-Sale/End-of-Line/Discontinued/Last-Chance terms. No page is explicitly named 'Clearance' or 'Outlet' in the consumer-facing sense (the only 'outlet' text found refers to Wonderchef's 20,000 physical retail outlets nationwide, not a product listing -- not included). Two candidates pass the PLP test but are genuinely ambiguous on the Sale-vs-Clearance distinction, so both are recorded with a MANUAL REVIEW flag per the brief rather than guessed either way: (1) /collections/wonderchef-renewed ('Wonderchef Renewed'), linked from main navigation -- the page's own FAQ describes it as unused-but-returned/open-box/cosmetically-marked stock sold separately from new stock, which is conceptually an Outlet/graded-stock program, but the site's own branding is 'Renewed' (a recommerce term), not an explicit Clearance/Outlet word. (2) /collections/eol-product-sale ('EOL product sale'), sitemap-only (not nav-linked) -- EOL conventionally abbreviates 'End of Line', a literal brief target term, but the page has no on-page copy beyond the bare title confirming permanent-clearance intent vs. a generic temporary sale. EXCLUDED (not emitted as rows, high confidence): /collections/end-of-season-sale (271 products) and its five price-tier variants (below-199/499/999/1999 and above-1999 end-of-season-sale, 108-226 each) -- explicitly named and framed as a seasonal/temporary promotional campaign with no permanence or outlet signal, matching the brief's exclusion of generic temporary sales. Also excluded for the same reason: 10th-anniversary-sale, black-friday-sale, cyber-monday-sale, flashsale, freedom-sale-2026, mega-sale, payday-sale, republic-day-sale, salary-day-sale, home-living-house-of-happiness-super-sale, nutri-blend-offer -- all named-campaign temporary promotions (anniversary/festival/payday/generic mega-sale), none carrying Clearance/Outlet/Final-Sale/End-of-Line/Discontinued signals. Qty confirmed via exhaustive products.json enumeration (paginated limit=250, deduped by product id); collections.json's own products_count field was inflated (120 vs actual 39 for eol-product-sale; 184 vs actual 138 for wonderchef-renewed) and was NOT used as the reported qty. A near-identical alias collection /collections/wonderchef-renewed-all (146 products, 137 of which overlap with the 138-product canonical /wonderchef-renewed) was found and treated as a duplicate of the canonical nav-linked listing per the brief's alias-merge rule, not emitted as a separate row.
